name: Party-wise Sample Report
query:
SELECT
	smr.party_type as "Party Type:Data:100",
	COALESCE(smr.party_name, smr.other_party_name) as "Party:Data:200",
	COUNT(*) as "Registers Sent:Int:120",
	SUM(CASE WHEN smr.status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Returned:Int:90",
	SUM(CASE WHEN smr.status = 'Written Off' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Written Off:Int:100",
	SUM(CASE WHEN smr.status IN ('Out', 'Partially Returned', 'Overdue', 'Escalated') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Still Out:Int:90",
	SUM(CASE WHEN smr.status IN ('Overdue', 'Escalated') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Overdue Now:Int:100",
	ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN smr.status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
		/ NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN smr.status IN ('Returned', 'Written Off') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) as "Return Rate (Closed):Percent:160"
FROM `tabSample Movement Register` smr
WHERE smr.docstatus = 1 AND smr.status NOT IN ('Approved')
GROUP BY smr.party_type, COALESCE(smr.party_name, smr.other_party_name)
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
